baseline_models.focus_anchor: The simile joins غلي at word 1 to الحميم at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pot-boiling branch supplies agitation and overflow while the hot-water branch supplies the heated medium, so the image is a threshold event rather than static temperature.

activation_trace.role: Pot boiling and overflow supplies the simile's motion and threshold.
Hot water supplies the literal medium whose heat is already active.

changed_reading.after: It behaves like charged liquid reaching agitation, boil, and possible overflow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rendering branch of ح م م remains attached to الحميم under the explicit غلي comparison.
baseline_models.mechanism: Boiling does not only transfer heat; it changes the composition of fatty material by liquefying it and leaving residue.

activation_trace.role: Boiling supplies the sustained thermal process that drives material change.
Rendered fat supplies liquefaction and residue as a material consequence of heat.

changed_reading.before: Hot water burns an object that remains materially separate.
changed_reading.after: The thermal process can render its material, making liquid, contents, and affected body difficult to keep separate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imminence and decree/death branches of ح م م are activated within the focus word الحميم, with غلي supplying culmination.
baseline_models.mechanism: An approaching, binding event reaches its due point as a boil reaches the threshold at which contained heat becomes manifest.

activation_trace.role: Imminence supplies the event's nearness and becoming due.
Decree and death supply a terminal event fixed rather than accidental.
Boiling over supplies the moment when a latent process becomes unavoidable and visible.

changed_reading.before: The phrase is only a thermal comparison.
changed_reading.after: The boil can also figure the due arrival of a decreed terminal event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus form الحميم carries both hot-water and intimate-friend branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two coexisting branches make nearness unstable: what could name protective intimacy can instead name the medium that comes unbearably close.

activation_trace.role: Hot water supplies harmful physical contact.
The intimate or near kinsman supplies an opposed social form of closeness.

changed_reading.before: الحميم names only a scalding liquid.
changed_reading.after: It can also carry a dangerous reversal of intimacy, where nearness scalds rather than shelters.

context_deltas.mechanism: Assigned and firmly fixed matters, death, and a timed gathering activate the focus branches of imminence and decree; boiling becomes the threshold at which an already appointed outcome arrives.

activation_trace.role: Imminence anchors the changed reading in the focus word as an event becoming present and due.
Decree and death make the focus event terminal and fixed.
Binding command supplies an outcome imposed rather than accidental.
Firm precision supplies the settled quality of the assigned matter.
Loss of life and force identifies the terminal pole latent in the focus branch.
A fixed time or limit supplies the scheduled threshold.
Gathering dispersed persons supplies collective convergence at that threshold.

structural_cues: 44:4 assigns every matter, 44:8 names death, and 44:40 fixes a collective appointment before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: binding matter, death, and timed gathering. Reader arrow: their convergence activates ح م م as due decree and treats boiling as its arrival threshold. Alternative: the timing language and the thermal simile may remain independent.

changed_reading.before: The boiling is an arbitrary episode of extreme heat.
changed_reading.after: The boiling is also the visible arrival of a fixed outcome whose time has come.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier rising smoke and its all-covering action activate the blackness, charcoal, and smoke branch of ح م م, adding opacity and residue to the focus boil.

activation_trace.role: Boiling over supplies the thermal source process.
Blackness, charcoal, and smoke supplies a dark product or residue within the focus root.
Smoke rising from fuel supplies the earlier atmospheric phase of the thermal process.
An all-covering veil expands the effect from a local boil to engulfing opacity.

structural_cues: The smoke in 44:10-11 precedes the compact thermal image in 44:46 and is described as covering people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: smoke rises and covers, while the focus root includes a soot-black branch. Reader arrow: these are phases of one material imagination, so the boil blackens as well as scalds. Alternative: the smoke and hot liquid may be separate punishment images.

changed_reading.before: The focus evokes transparent scalding water.
changed_reading.after: It can evoke an opaque, soot-bearing thermal event whose vapor and residue engulf as well as burn.

context_deltas.mechanism: A covering is lifted only a little and return follows; this sequence activates boiling as pressure-release-reaccumulation rather than a single uninterrupted state.

activation_trace.role: Repeated bubbling and overflow supplies a cyclic physical anchor in the focus.
Lifting a cover supplies temporary release.
Smallness limits the release instead of ending the process.
Return after departure supplies renewed accumulation after release.

structural_cues: Within 44:15, slight uncovering is immediately followed by return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: limited uncovering followed by return. Reader arrow: map that sequence onto a pot's release and renewed boil. Alternative: the return describes human recidivism, not recurrence in the punishment medium.

changed_reading.before: The boil is one continuous terminal state.
changed_reading.after: The boil can pulse through partial release and renewed pressure, making reprieve part of the torment's rhythm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Social self-elevation is reversed into involuntary fluid rise and top-down domination: the one who rose in arrogance becomes boiling contents dragged below and struck from above.

activation_trace.role: Boiling over supplies involuntary upward motion that can parody chosen exaltation.
Arrogant self-magnification supplies the rejected social ascent.
Height supplies the earlier vertical status assigned to Pharaoh.
Violent dragging supplies forced downward relocation.
Dominance from above supplies the reversed hierarchy's direction.
Overpowering force supplies the status claim exposed by actual coercion.
Boasting in honor supplies the second title caught in the reversal.

structural_cues: The prohibition of self-exaltation and Pharaoh's height precede dragging to the center, pouring from above, and the paired status titles in 44:47-49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated height/status language and a later vertical coercion sequence. Reader arrow: fluid rise in the focus parodies arrogant ascent and is defeated by force from above. Alternative: the moral titles and liquid mechanics may be parallel but unmapped motifs.

changed_reading.before: Boiling is only a measure of heat intensity.
changed_reading.after: Boiling upward becomes a thermodynamic parody of status: self-exaltation ends as involuntary overflow under superior force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failure of one close patron to aid another activates the intimate-friend branch of الحميم; the mercy exception preserves one efficacious relation, making the focus liquid an inversion of failed protective nearness.

activation_trace.role: The intimate kinsman or friend anchors relational nearness in the focus form.
Scalding water turns nearness from protection into harmful contact.
Love, support, and alliance supplies the expected help explicitly made ineffective.
Aid supplies the blocked function of close relations.
Merciful tenderness supplies the explicit exception to failed human support.
Kinship supplies a relational near-neighbor to the focus root's intimate branch.

structural_cues: 44:41 negates aid between paired patrons; 44:42 immediately marks mercy as the exception before the punishment image begins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: failed patronal aid, then mercy, plus an intimate branch inside الحميم. Reader arrow: read the hot medium as a reversal of closeness that could not save. Alternative: الحميم may function only as hot water, with no relational resonance.

changed_reading.before: The liquid is physically near but socially neutral.
changed_reading.after: Its nearness can ironize failed intimacy: the absent protective close one is replaced by a close medium that harms.

context_deltas.mechanism: Swallowing becomes food, the food acquires the material behavior of molten deposits, and it boils inside; the rendering branch of ح م م then makes the sequence resemble digestive metallurgy that can liquefy both contents and eater.

activation_trace.role: Boiling and overflow anchors the focus as an active internal process.
Rendering fat supplies liquefaction and residue, extending the focus beyond ordinary water.
Swallowing supplies entry of the harmful material into the body.
Taking and tasting food makes ingestion, not external contact, the initial route.
Molten substances and sediment supply a heavy, transformative material analogy.
The contextual verb supplies the same boiling process immediately before the focus simile.
The interior supplies the bodily vessel in which the transformation occurs.

structural_cues: 44:43-46 runs from swallowable tree, to food, to molten material boiling in interiors, to the focus comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: ingestion, molten deposits, boiling, and bodily interior. Reader arrow: the ح م م rendering branch lets the process extend from food toward the eater's own fatty material. Alternative: only the ingested food boils while the body remains a passive container.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely compares the food's heat to hot water.
changed_reading.after: It completes an internal rendering process in which the eater becomes vessel, contents, and potentially rendered material.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus becomes a hinge between boiling in the interior and hot liquid poured over the head; dragging to the fire's center nests the body spatially, so heat attacks from within, around, and above.

activation_trace.role: Boiling supplies the internal upward motion at the circuit's hinge.
Hot water identifies the thermal medium repeated on the outer side of the hinge.
The interior supplies the first spatial domain of the boil.
Violent dragging makes the body a moved object between thermal domains.
The middle supplies enclosure at the fire's spatial center.
Blazing fire supplies the surrounding thermal field.
Pouring supplies the external liquid's directed motion.
Upper position fixes the source above the body.
The head supplies the upper bodily boundary struck by the pour.
Painful punishment assigns the pour's function rather than leaving it a neutral wash.
The repeated hot-water branch closes the circuit with the same medium outside the body.

structural_cues: 44:45 locates boiling in interiors; 44:46 names its hot-water likeness; 44:47-48 moves the body to the center and pours hot water over its head.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: interior boil, central relocation, and an upper external pour of the same named medium. Reader arrow: treat 44:46 as a spatial hinge that encloses the body between internal and external heat. Alternative: the internal simile and later pour may be consecutive but independent torments.

changed_reading.before: The focus is local to what boils in the belly.
changed_reading.after: It is the pivot of a total-exposure circuit: heat rises within, surrounds at the center, and descends from above.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to taste turns the focus simile from observed fluid behavior into lived evidence; the titles of might and honor are then tested against an experience that demonstrates actual overpowering force.

activation_trace.role: Boiling supplies the phenomenon that moves from comparison into experience.
Hot water supplies what is sensorially undergone rather than merely seen.
Experiencing and being tried converts the image into an evidentiary test.
Overpowering supplies the claim of might measured against actual subjection.
Commended honor supplies the second status claim exposed by the test.

structural_cues: The first imperative after the boiling and pouring sequence is the singular command to taste, followed immediately by two status titles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: experiential tasting follows coercive heating and precedes might/honor titles. Reader arrow: the experience functions as a verdict that ironizes those titles. Alternative: the titles could be quoted without mapping their collapse onto the focus simile.

changed_reading.before: The phrase offers a spectator's comparison of one liquid to another.
changed_reading.after: The comparison becomes compulsory knowledge: boiling is tasted as the test that overturns claimed invulnerability and honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dominant mapping names doubt while a non-dominant mapped root supplies oscillation and recurrent flow; together they let the focus boil materialize epistemic wavering as fluid turbulence.

activation_trace.role: Boiling over supplies visible unstable motion anchored in the focus.
Doubt and hesitation supplies the epistemic state named after the punishment sequence.
The non-dominant mapped branch of wavering and turbulence supplies a fluid analogue for doubt.
Recurrently pouring flow sharpens the link between oscillation and the surrounding liquid sequence.

structural_cues: 44:50 retrospectively names what was doubted immediately after boiling, pouring, and tasting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: doubt plus a split mapped inventory containing turbulence and recurrent flow. Reader arrow: let the non-dominant material branch externalize the dominant epistemic state in the focus boil. Alternative: the split mapping may be only lexical adjacency with no poetic activation.

changed_reading.before: The boiling confirms a proposition that had been doubted.
changed_reading.after: Its oscillating fluid motion can also embody the doubters' own wavering, turning uncertainty into the medium they undergo.

context_deltas.mechanism: Secure dwelling, flowing springs, and protection from punishment establish a second water regime; the focus hot water is therefore not water made evil in itself but water weaponized by heat, placement, and relation.

activation_trace.role: Hot water supplies the punitive water regime in the focus.
Bathing place and heating vessel keeps cleansing infrastructure latent inside the same focus root.
Settled safety supplies the relation under which the later environment is habitable.
A source of flowing water supplies the beneficial counterpart to heated liquid.
Protection that repels harm supplies separation from the punitive regime.
Pain and punishment specifies what protection excludes.
Blazing heat supplies the destructive condition absent from the spring environment.

structural_cues: After 44:46-50, the scene pivots to secure dwelling and springs, then explicitly names protection from fiery punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: hot water in punishment contrasts with safe springs and explicit protection from blazing harm. Reader arrow: treat the focus as an inverted bath or spring whose medium is weaponized by its thermal relation. Alternative: the scenes may simply contrast outcomes without asking how water changes function.

changed_reading.before: الحميم is an intrinsically evil substance opposed to all water.
changed_reading.after: The focus marks a corrupted water relation: spring and bath potential remains, but heat and coercive placement turn the medium against the body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links distant liquid scenes and opposite motions; it remains anchored in the focus's hot-water boil and in branch-backed stillness and drowning at 44:24. Render only as a cross-scene fluid-regime analogy, not as identity between the sea and الحميم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines boiling motion with hot liquid, allowing comparison with an earlier lethal liquid in a still state.

activation_trace.role: Boiling over supplies the violently moving liquid regime.
Hot water keeps the outlier anchored in liquid rather than generic motion.
Abundant open water supplies the earlier liquid field.
Gentle stillness supplies the opposite fluid state.
Drowning supplies lethality through engulfment rather than heat.

changed_reading.before: Only violently boiling liquid is dangerous.
changed_reading.after: The surah's liquids can kill in opposed regimes: still water engulfs, while hot water convulses and penetrates.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a deliberately branch-distant wordplay because the vessel-lid branch of ك ر م is far from the title's ordinary force; it remains anchored by the focus's pot boil, the bodily interior, and the later head-pour. Render as a fleeting material echo, never as the lexical meaning of كريم in 44:49.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pot-like boiling at word 1 and heating-vessel branch at word 2 permit a tightly contained body-as-vessel model.

activation_trace.role: A pot boiling over supplies the vessel mechanics.
A heating vessel supplies containment around the hot medium.
The bodily interior supplies the vessel cavity.
The head supplies the body's upper boundary.
The remote lid-on-a-vessel branch supplies a contained upper closure as wordplay.

changed_reading.before: The belly merely contains boiling food and كريم is only a status title.
changed_reading.after: For an instant the body can resemble a lidded heating vessel whose contents boil and whose upper boundary is then assaulted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the low horse-sound branch is form-distant from hot water; it remains anchored in the exact focus root and in boiling's audible physical behavior. Render only as an acoustic association, not as a claim that الحميم denotes a sound here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both branches are cited from the two focus words, allowing the visible boil to acquire a restrained sound layer.

activation_trace.role: Boiling over supplies bubbling and rumbling as a physically audible process.
A low sound below a full neigh supplies a constrained acoustic register.

changed_reading.before: The comparison is silent and visual-thermal.
changed_reading.after: It may also be heard as a low contained rumble that precedes or accompanies overflow.

strongest_changes: The immediate ingestion sequence turns the focus from generic heat into internal rendering of molten material.
The following drag-and-pour sequence makes 44:46 a hinge between heat rising inside and hot water descending outside.
Failed patronal aid and the mercy exception activate a coexisting relational inversion inside الحميم.
The split mapping at 44:50 lets epistemic doubt coexist with a material reading of fluid turbulence.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus acts as a dense switchboard: literal hot-water boiling remains primary while rendering, due decree, failed intimacy, blackening, vertical reversal, sensory proof, and turbulence remain simultaneously live rather than being merged.
remaining_uncertainties: Extending rendered fat from the ingested substance to the eater's body is an abductive move, not an explicit directional statement.
Smoke/blackening and boiling may be phases of one material imagination or separate punishment scenes.
The sea-regime, vessel-lid, and acoustic readings are branch-backed but intentionally exploratory and should remain qualified.
